title: Finite-coefficient geometric-fiber formula
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper, let $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ be
geometric, and let $i_{\bar y}:X_{\bar y}\to X$ and $a_{\bar y}:X_{\bar
y}\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ be the projections. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite
ring and let $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$. The etale base-change morphism is
an isomorphism

$$
 \bar y^{-1}Rf_*K\xrightarrow{\sim}
 Ra_{\bar y,*}i_{\bar y}^{-1}K.
$$

For a finite $\Lambda$-module sheaf $F$ this gives, for every $q\geq0$,

$$
 (R^qf_*F)_{\bar y}\xrightarrow{\sim}
 H^q(X_{\bar y},F|_{X_{\bar y}}).
$$

proof.text: Setup. Put $Y'=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, $g=\bar y$, $X'=X_{\bar y}=X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ (the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]), $g'=i_{\bar y}$ and $f'=a_{\bar y}$ the two projections. With the identification $\alpha=\mathrm{id}:X_{\bar y}\to X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ this is a cartesian square $\square_{\bar y}=(f,a_{\bar y},\bar y,i_{\bar y},\mathrm{id})$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with $f$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. The etale base-change morphism of the statement is the derived exchange morphism $\Ex^\Lambda_{\square_{\bar y},K}$ of [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] for this square, formed for $\Lambda$-module sheaves.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0DDF (lemma-proper-base-change-stalk) and its proof: 'X_{\bar y}=\bar y\times_Y X' is the scheme theoretic fibre and the pullback by $\bar y$

proof.text: $K$ has torsion cohomology. Let $n=\#\Lambda\geq1$. The additive group of $\Lambda$ has order $n$, so $n\cdot1_\Lambda=0$ (Lagrange), hence every $\Lambda$-module sheaf $M$ is killed by $n$: for every etale $U$ and $s\in M(U)$, $ns=(n\cdot1_\Lambda)s=0$. Each cohomology sheaf $\mathcal H^q(K)$ is a $\Lambda$-module sheaf, so its underlying abelian sheaf is torsion in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] (take the trivial covering and $n_i=n$). Let $\operatorname{For}K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$ be the underlying complex of abelian sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients]; since $\operatorname{For}$ is exact, $\mathcal H^q(\operatorname{For}K)=\operatorname{For}\mathcal H^q(K)$, so $\operatorname{For}K$ is bounded below with torsion cohomology [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

source.place: Lemma Tag 0DDE (lemma-proper-base-change), hypothesis 'E in D^+(X_et) has torsion cohomology sheaves'; Lambda-module complexes reduced to abelian ones as in Tag 0D6J

proof.text: First formula. By [thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below] applied to the cartesian square $\square_{\bar y}$ of step 1 (with $f$ proper) and to $\operatorname{For}K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$, which has torsion cohomology by step 2, the derived exchange morphism of abelian sheaves $\Ex_{\square_{\bar y},\operatorname{For}K}:\bar y^{-1}Rf_*\operatorname{For}K\to Ra_{\bar y,*}i_{\bar y}^{-1}\operatorname{For}K$ is an isomorphism in $\Dplus((\operatorname{Spec}\Omega)_{\Et})$. By [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients] (last assertion) the $\Lambda$-linear exchange morphism $\Ex^\Lambda_{\square_{\bar y},K}:\bar y^{-1}Rf_*K\to Ra_{\bar y,*}i_{\bar y}^{-1}K$ is then an isomorphism in $\Dplus((\operatorname{Spec}\Omega)_{\Et},\Lambda)$. This is the first displayed formula.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0DDF (lemma-proper-base-change-stalk) and its proof part (2): 'a special case of Lemma [0DDE]'

proof.text: Cohomology sheaves of the left side. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ (finiteness of $F$ is not used) and apply step 3 to $K=F[0]$. The functor $\bar y^{-1}$ is exact on sheaves [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] (a left adjoint, Stacks Tag 03Q1 (1); it is computed termwise on complexes), so $\mathcal H^q(\bar y^{-1}Rf_*F)=\bar y^{-1}\mathcal H^q(Rf_*F)=\bar y^{-1}R^qf_*F$ with $R^qf_*F=\mathcal H^q(Rf_*F)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. By [lem-weil-pbc-geometric-point-pullback-stalk] (2), applied to the underlying abelian sheaf, $\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,\bar y^{-1}R^qf_*F)\cong(R^qf_*F)_{\bar y}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]; the isomorphism is $\Lambda$-linear because it is natural in the sheaf and the $\Lambda$-action is by sheaf endomorphisms.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0DDF (lemma-proper-base-change-stalk) and its proof: 'pulling back by $\bar y\to Y$ produces the stalk'; Remark Tag 04JN

proof.text: Cohomology sheaves of the right side. Write $G=i_{\bar y}^{-1}F=F|_{X_{\bar y}}$ and $P=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$. By [lem-weil-pbc-geometric-point-pullback-stalk] (1), $\Gamma(P,-)$ is exact on (abelian or $\Lambda$-module) sheaves on $P_{\Et}$. Hence for every bounded below complex $M$ on $P_{\Et}$ the map $\Gamma(P,M)\to\Gamma(P,I)$ to a K-injective resolution $M\to I$ is a quasi-isomorphism (an exact functor preserves quasi-isomorphisms, the cone of $M\to I$ being acyclic), i.e. $\RGamma(P,M)=\Gamma(P,M)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], and $\Gamma(P,\mathcal H^q(M))=\mathcal H^q(\Gamma(P,M))=H^q(P,M)$. Apply this to $M=Ra_{\bar y,*}G$: $\Gamma(P,\mathcal H^q(Ra_{\bar y,*}G))=H^q(\RGamma(P,Ra_{\bar y,*}G))$, and by the composition of derived functors $\RGamma(P,Ra_{\bar y,*}G)\cong\RGamma(X_{\bar y},G)$ [lem-kun-leray-bdd] this is $H^q(X_{\bar y},G)=H^q(X_{\bar y},F|_{X_{\bar y}})$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. (For the $\Lambda$-module version, the abelian groups so computed agree with those computed with $\Lambda$-module resolutions by [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients] (2) and the case $u=a_{\bar y}$ of that comparison together with $\Gamma(P,-)$ exact.)

source.place: Expose XII, paragraph before Corollaire 5.2 (p. 88-89 of the original): 'un faisceau sur xi est determine par ses sections globales, on a H^0(xi, R^q f'_* G)=H^q(X',G)'

proof.text: Second formula. Apply $\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,\mathcal H^q(-))$ to the isomorphism $\Ex^\Lambda_{\square_{\bar y},F[0]}$ of step 3. By steps 4 and 5 its source becomes $(R^qf_*F)_{\bar y}$ and its target $H^q(X_{\bar y},F|_{X_{\bar y}})$, so for every $q\geq0$ we obtain the isomorphism $(R^qf_*F)_{\bar y}\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(X_{\bar y},F|_{X_{\bar y}})$; an isomorphism stays one after applying the functor $\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,\mathcal H^q(-))$.

split_report.summary: Rewrote the one-line imported proof as six steps following Stacks Tag 0DDF (proper base change at a geometric stalk) and SGA 4 XII Cor. 5.2(iii). The blueprint proof specialized prop-weil-proet-finite-proper-base-change, which is stated only for a torsion sheaf F, while the first formula is for complexes K in D^+(X_et, Lambda); the proof now uses thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below (Stacks 0DDE) directly, and prop-weil-proet-finite-proper-base-change is no longer used. Hidden arguments made into new nodes: lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients (Lambda-linear exchange vs. the abelian one, Stacks 0D6J/07A7: the existing theorems are for abelian sheaves) and lem-weil-pbc-geometric-point-pullback-stalk (inverse image to Spec Omega is the stalk, Gamma(Spec Omega,-) an exact equivalence, Stacks 03Q1/04JN/04JQ). Torsionness of Lambda-module cohomology (n = #Lambda) and the derivation of the stalk formula (exactness of pullback and of Gamma on Spec Omega, Leray composition lem-kun-leray-bdd) are written out. stmt_deps: def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions replaced by the reviewed leaves def-weil-proper-morphism and def-weil-geometric-point, plus the notions the statement uses (fibre product, Lambda-module derived categories, exchange morphism, Rf_*, inverse image, stalk, etale cohomology). The hypothesis 'finite' on F is not used.
